context: Mrs. Mori visits Yumiko now in the country.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 優子さん、来てくれて、本当、嬉しい。
lines.en: Yumiko-san, I'm so glad you came.
lines.style: Warm, genuine smile in the voice. Slow, unhurried pace. Soft opening that gives the other person time to land. The genuine pleasure of seeing an old friend — no performance, just real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Mori-san, you look well. I'm relieved.
lines.style: Quiet affection underneath. Matter-of-fact about the relief — not gushy. Steady, maternal tone. A beat of actual concern that just passed, now settled.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Time together like this — it's really precious.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reflective. Slight pause before 'precious.' Not heavy, but grounded. The words come from somewhere real. Gentle lingering at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Such a long friendship between us, truly.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Like she's just noticing the length of it again, right now. Warm acknowledgment. A little catch of genuine affection on 'truly.'

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: I'm grateful — truly, for all these years.
lines.style: Deeper in the voice. Not formal, but sincere weight. The gratitude is actual. Slow breath underneath. Trailing softly, like there's more that doesn't need saying.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 楽しい、毎日、過ごしてる。
lines.en: Every day with you in it has been joyful.
lines.style: Warm and unhurried. Not overselling it — just factual kindness. The comfort of certainty in how she feels. Steady maternal presence breathing through the line.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Let's keep going forward together, shall we?
lines.style: Gentle promise in the tone. Slow, closing-warm delivery. The softness of asking, not demanding. Reaching across the years with quiet affection. A gentle full stop.
